summary: Implementation plan for an exact, pixel-for-pixel, word-for-word, and asset-for-asset mirror replica of Sansad Showdown: The Great Kursi Fight (fightkaro.com), including all 9 3D rigged GLB character models, WebP portraits, voiceovers, music/SFX, Draco decoder assets, and a complete Express WebRTC room signaling backend (/api/room and /api/ice).
